---
name: architecture-adr
description: Creates or reviews Athena architecture decisions involving contracts, trust boundaries, storage, identity, MCP, or cross-component behavior.
---

Read `ARCHITECTURE.md` first. Record status, context, decision, alternatives, consequences, security
impact, operational impact, compatibility, and rollback. Explicitly test whether the proposal
duplicates Azure MCP or weakens the context/evidence identity boundary. Do not implement before the
decision is approved.
